card.name: Archaic "ye" in quoted scripture
card.fires_on: The archaic pronoun "ye" in biblical or old-style quoted speech, especially right after a verb such as "do", "take" or "will". It also fires weakly on stray odd characters inside garbled or split words.

modes.label: Archaic ye
modes.description: The word "ye" in scripture or old-fashioned dialogue, after a verb.

modes.label: Odd characters in words
modes.description: Unusual letters or symbols appearing inside brand names or garbled medical text.

card.plain: It lights up on the old word "ye" in Bible-style quotes, and weakly on odd stray letters in words.
